name: Enough With Living as a Hero
source:
Ten years ago The Great Demon Lord was slain by the legendary hero, Helio, who reclaimed peace in the Rhitheos empire after years of war and strife. However, the hero who fulfilled the prophecy to restore peace in the lands has since died after the final battle, never able to see the lasting impact of his actions...

Until now. Ten years later. In the room of a mage in training. 

Waking in an unfamiliar room with a second chance of life after death, a contract between two souls is hastily made by the hands of a young necromancer.  The hero now finds himself in a bind (literally), and must overcome his own challenges to figure out his purpose of being resurrected. 

[From [url=https://alienbluez.itch.io/enough-with-living-as-a-hero]itch.io[/url]]
